interpolate_2d_inplace: interpolate missing values in a 2D numpy array using linear or scipy-based methods with limit and limit_area control
pad_or_backfill_inplace: perform forward-fill or back-fill on a 2D numpy array in-place with optional limit and limit_area constraints
clean_fill_method: normalize a fill method string converting ffill to pad and bfill to backfill with optional nearest support
mask_missing: create a boolean mask identifying entries in an array equal to a given value handling extension array dtypes
clean_interp_method: validate and normalize an interpolation method name checking scipy availability and index monotonicity requirements
